reviews.rationale: Sequential comparison of selected Q2 and Q3 SEC exhibit rows shows a mixed quarter rather than a clean deterioration or improvement. Supporting the existing active thesis: GAAP net interest income and net interest income after provision both rose sequentially, with interest income growing faster than interest expense, so the core spread engine still contributed positively. Preferred dividends also rose, further reducing the common-attributable result.
